_note: web.* feeds apps/game/web/pixl.css. godot.* feeds apps/game/theme.json. The web set is PIXL PAPER: the landing site's neo-brutalist look (cream paper, black rules, hard offset shadows, Hack Club red and orange) ported onto the shell and docs so the marketing page and the signed-in product read as one brand. godot.* is deliberately NOT part of that port yet, the game still runs the older LEDGER gold on charcoal, so the two objects no longer share values. godot.light does not exist: the game has no light-mode design, so PixlTheme falls back to godot.dark whenever a synced 'light' choice reaches the game.
